title: Relationship Pricing Note: Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance Addition to SecureRate Default Renewal Rates
content:
The owner's Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, and the premiums recently paid on it, add to the default renewal rate of the owner's Ashgrove SecureRate contract (Deferred Fixed Annuities).

## Rule

The whole life relationship addition to the default renewal rate is:

- **0.10% (0.001)** where the owner has an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy on record, whatever its current status, showing at least **12** premium payments in the twelve months before the renewal is recorded;
- **0.05% (0.0005)** where the owner has an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy on record, whatever its current status, showing at least one but fewer than 12 such payments;
- nothing otherwise.

The addition is made to the tier's current base rate; the default renewal rate including it is held at no less than the guaranteed minimum interest rate and rounded to four decimal places.

## Records read

The owner's Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy on record (in force, lapsed, surrendered or any other status) and the premium payment entries in its activity history dated in the twelve months before the renewal is recorded.

## Judgement table

| Whole Life Insurance policy on record | Premium payments in those twelve months | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| Yes, any status | 12 or more | 0.10% |
| Yes, any status | 1 to 11 | 0.05% |
| Yes, any status | None | Nothing |
| No | — | Nothing |

*Worked case (hypothetical):* a whole life policy that lapsed last month after 11 monthly premium payments in the twelve months gives 0.05%.
